nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What does the paper's structure include after presenting the IFCG framework?
nodes.answer: After presenting the IFCG framework, the paper includes sections on the research design and data collection processes, results, and discussions of the findings in light of theoretical expectations.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Public-private synergy|Contractual frameworks_qna_001
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What is the main purpose of the operationalising framework presented in the paper?
nodes.answer: The main purpose of the operationalising framework is to assist research teams in preparing for co-production by encouraging critical evaluation of their research contexts and interactions involving positionality, purpose, contextual and stakeholder power, and tailoring of co-production processes.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Industry, innovation and infrastructure|Public-private synergy|Contractual frameworks_qna_002
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the potential application of the framework and diagnostic questions beyond the preparatory phase?
nodes.answer: They are likely applicable to later work with collaborators and could support iterative re-application of the critical lens throughout the life of a project.
